description: This PHP file contains utility functions related to the installation process of the TestLink open source test management system. It includes functions for locating SQL files in directories, retrieving database schema information (such as table lists and user lists), creating database users and assigning privileges across different database systems (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL), and checking system dependencies like PHP extensions and PEAR modules.

methods.name: getDirSqlFiles
methods.description: Recursively scans directories to find .sql files and returns a list of file paths grouped by directory.

methods.name: getTableList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of table names from a given database connection.

methods.name: getUserList
methods.description: Fetches a list of existing database users for supported database types (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL).

methods.name: create_user_for_db
methods.description: Creates a new database user and grants appropriate privileges depending on the database type.

methods.name: close_html_and_exit
methods.description: Outputs closing HTML tags and terminates script execution.

methods.name: check_pear_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of required PEAR PHP modules, specifically Spreadsheet_Excel_Writer.

methods.name: check_db_loaded_extension
methods.description: Verifies if the necessary PHP database extensions (e.g., pgsql, mysqli) are loaded based on the database type.

methods.name: _mysql_make_user
methods.description: Constructs and executes MySQL commands to create a new user account with proper password configuration.

methods.name: _mysql_assign_grants
methods.description: Assigns database privileges (SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE, INSERT) to a user in MySQL.

methods.name: _postgres_make_user_with_grants
methods.description: Creates a PostgreSQL user and grants privileges.

methods.name: _postgres_make_user
methods.description: Creates a new PostgreSQL user with specified password.

methods.name: _postgres_assign_grants
methods.description: Assigns privileges to a PostgreSQL user on a database.

methods.name: _mssql_make_user_with_grants
methods.description: Creates a MSSQL login and grant privileges.

methods.name: _mssql_assign_grants
methods.description: Grants database permissions to a MSSQL login.

methods.name: _mssql_set_passwd
methods.description: Sets or resets the password for a MSSQL login.

methods.name: important_reminder
methods.description: Outputs an important reminder message about configuring mail server settings for the installation.
